notes: Real-paper gold case from STUDY-d7633d624b5a, DOI 10.1111/1755-0998.13677, PMCID PMC9796769. Curated from stored Europe PMC full-text evidence for the sponge eDNA persistence study.
source_text: Each sponge was removed from the storage ethanol, blotted dry against filter paper (42.5 mm, Fisher Scientific) inside a Petri dish. Each filter capsule was opened onto a Petri dish using carpenter pliers. The filters were removed from the inner tube and torn into small pieces using metal forceps. All samples were processed using the Mu-DNA tissue protocol with an inhibitor removal step from the Mu-DNA water protocol. The libraries were sequenced on an Illumina iSeq100 using iSeq i1 Reagent version 2 (300 cycles) at Liverpool John Moores University with a final molarity of 60 pM.
